lesson.child_mission: Reading an argument means finding the claim, the supporting reasons and deciding whether the support is relevant and enough.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Find the claim and one support in: "Our class should borrow more science kits. Hands-on kits help us remember investigations."

FEEDBACK
Claim: borrow more science kits. Support: kits help memory of investigations.

CHECK
A story detail that does not connect to the claim is not useful support.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Read two short argument paragraphs. For each, identify claim, two supports and one weak or missing support. Explain which argument is stronger and why.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Claim: "The oval needs shade sails." Support: "Students wait in full sun for sport." The support is relevant because it links heat to the request.

TRY FIRST
Find the claim and one support in: "Our class should borrow more science kits. Hands-on kits help us remember investigations."

FEEDBACK
Claim: borrow more science kits. Support: kits help memory of investigations.
teach_steps.explain:
Reading an argument means finding the claim, the supporting reasons and deciding whether the support is relevant and enough.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner make decisions based on specific language evidence, rather than guess or copy someone else. Keep the meaning accurate and explain the choice.

HOW TO WORK
Read the original example and locate the words or actions that support the idea. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Check your response against the feedback: did you address the same skill and show your reasoning? If a detail is uncertain, identify what would have to be checked. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than making the answer longer.
teach_steps.notice: A story detail that does not connect to the claim is not useful support. Correct the meaning, not just the appearance.
